guide_text:
RIFT BOMBER · LOCAL VERSUS
Arena rules
Controls
P1 · WASD
Move your selected champion. Space always plants the arena bomb.
Katarina · Q/F/E/R
Bouncing Blade, Preparation, Shunpo and Death Lotus. F replaces W because W is forward movement.
Voracity
Walk over a grounded dagger to spin, slash nearby targets and heavily reduce Shunpo’s cooldown.
Zed · Q/F/E/R
Razor Shuriken, Living Shadow, Shadow Slash and Death Mark. Press F again to exchange places with the living shadow.
Renekton · Q/F/E/R
Cull the Meek, Ruthless Predator, Slice and Dice, and Dominus. Fury empowers Q or F at 50.
Vladimir · Q/F/E/R
Transfusion, Sanguine Pool, Tides of Blood and Hemoplague. F replaces W because W moves the champion.
Ziggs · Q/Shift
Q plants a bomb and Left Shift triggers Satchel burst.
P2 · Arrows
Move Red Ziggs. Enter or Numpad 0 plants a bomb; Right Shift triggers Satchel burst.
Solo play
The CPU controls Red until Player 2 presses an arrow key or Enter.
M
Mute or restore the original soundtrack.
P
Paus
